info.title: MetaEngine.CSharp.GraphQL.HttpClient.Tool
info.description: Command-line dotnet tool that generates idiomatic C# HttpClient services and models from a GraphQL schema (SDL) — query/mutation/subscription clients with System.Text.Json models. Wraps the MetaEngine.CSharp.GraphQL.HttpClient engine.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Generate C# HttpClient services and models from a GraphQL schema (SDL)

options.name: --documentation
options.description: Generate XML doc comments from GraphQL SDL descriptions [default: False]

options.name: --error-handling
options.description: Enable smart error handling based on HTTP status semantics [default: False]

options.name: --bearer-auth
options.description: Bearer token from env var (default API_TOKEN). Adds an Authorization header to all requests.

options.name: --basic-auth
options.description: Basic auth from env vars (API_USERNAME / API_PASSWORD). [default: False]

options.name: --retries
options.description: Enable retries with exponential backoff. Optional value sets max attempts.

options.name: --custom-header
options.description: Static header from env var. Repeatable. Format: <header-name>=<env-var-name> (e.g. X-Tenant-ID=TENANT_ID)

options.name: --subscription-url
options.description: Path appended to the WebSocket base URL for GraphQL subscriptions (default /graphql). Baked into the generated BaseHttpClient.

options.name: --fragments
options.description: Emit reusable named fragments for object-type selections (...TypeFields spreads). [default: False]

options.name: --oneof-inputs
options.description: Generate idiomatic @oneOf input types (tagged-union inputs where exactly one field is set). [default: False]

options.name: --custom-scalar
options.description: Map a GraphQL custom scalar to a .NET type. Repeatable. Format: <GraphQLScalar>=<FullyQualifiedDotNetType> (e.g. DateTime=System.DateTime)

options.name: --include-types
options.description: Only generate these GraphQL types (comma-separated type names)

options.name: --clean
options.description: Clean the destination directory before generating [default: False]

arguments.name: INPUT
arguments.description: GraphQL schema (SDL) file path or inline SDL content

arguments.name: OUTPUT
arguments.description: Output directory for generated C# files

arguments.name: NAMESPACE
arguments.description: Root namespace for the generated client and models
